data.text: MPC SUBMIX / INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL CARRIER
INTERNAL: INSERT VOCKIT ON VOCAL AUDIO TRACK
SET INPUT MODE TO INTERNAL AND MIX TO 100%
JURA: PAN SYNTH LEFT, VOICE RIGHT, BOTH TO SUBMIX 1
SELECT L CARRIER / R VOICE FOR JURA
MIC: ENABLE AUDIO INPUT MONITORING; USE HEADPHONES
FOR CLEAR SPEECH: BRIGHT CARRIER, SHORT RELEASE
SAVE AND LOAD PRESETS USING MPC PRESET MENU
